summary: Defines procedures and messages for providing BGP-based services over Segment Routing over IPv6 (SRv6), including Layer 3 VPN, Ethernet VPN, and Internet services. It builds on BGP/MPLS IP VPNs (RFC 4364) and BGP MPLS-Based Ethernet VPN (RFC 7432), replacing MPLS labels with SRv6 mechanisms. It is a standards-track specification.

eli5.summary: Companies often rent private lanes on a shared network. This explains how to offer those private lanes using IPv6 addresses as the road directions instead of the older label stickers.
